# Sentiment Analysis

`customer_support.voice_of_customer.sentiment_analysis` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · **STUB**

**What is the tone of this conversation telling us, and how much of it should we believe?**


> Reading the emotional state of a conversation, and holding it apart from the state of the relationship. Polite is not satisfied and blunt is not hostile — the customer who writes short, factual, unfailingly civil messages after a long ordeal has usually already decided, while the one shouting is still bargaining. Sentiment is most useful as a change detector against how this particular person normally writes, and least useful as an absolute label, which is exactly the way most tooling reports it.
